title: BRP U.S. Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Friction between the fuel hose and the cylinder head cover can cause the hose to pierce. This can cause fuel to leak out, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 430 (This recall was first announced in May 2008).

title: Children's Merry-Go-Rounds Sold Exclusively at Toys R Us Recalled by Pacific Cycle Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The inner bearing on the merry-go-round can fail, causing the seat assembly to suddenly drop to the ground. This poses a fall hazard to children riding the merry-go-round. Units: About 15,000.

title: Children's Overalls Recalled by Sara Lynn Togs Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The buttons on the shoulder straps can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,800.

title: Robert Bosch Tool Corp. Recalls Hammer Drills Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The drill can continue to operate after the trigger has been released, posing a risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 9,700.

title: Sauna By Airwall Recalls Infra-Red Sauna Rooms Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The heating unit and fuse can fail, leading to overheating of the saunas. This defect can result in a serious fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 225.

title: MTD Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Excessive heat can cause the wiring harness to melt. This defect can result in a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 700.

title: Backyard Leisure Recalls Swing Sets Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Hangers holding the chains for the gliders can break, causing a child to fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 11,000.

title: Crate and Barrel Recalls Shag Rugs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The large rugs fail to meet federal standards for flammability and could ignite, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. The small rugs fail to meet federal labeling requirements. title: Progress Lighting Recalls Ceiling-Mounted Indoor Light Fixtures; Lights Can Fall Posing an Impact Hazard
summary: A cable that supports the light fixture from the ceiling can fail, causing the fixture to fall and injure nearby consumers. Units: About 7,500.

title: The Children's Place Recalls Camouflage Pajama Sets Due to Excessive Lead
summary: The screen print on the shirt contains excess levels of lead. Units: About 28,000.

title: Children's Jackets and Hoodies with Drawstrings Recalled by Coolibar Inc. Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 3,000.

title: E-Z-GO Recalls RXV Golf Cars Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The hip restraints on the cars can detach at the base, posing a fall and injury risk to consumers. Units: About 16,500.

title: Hewlett-Packard Co. Recalls Fax Machines Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An internal electrical component failure can cause overheating of the product posing a risk of burn or fire. Units: About 367,000 units (an additional 84,000 units sold outside of the U.S.).

title: ATVs Recalled By Kawasaki Due to Loss of Speed Control
summary: The throttle can fail to return to the idle position when released or could fail to be at idle on start-up. This could result in loss of vehicle control, posing a risk of serious injury or death to the rider. Units: About 6,000.

title: ATVs Recalled By KYMCO Due to Loss of Speed Control
summary: A manufacturing defect in the carburetor can cause the throttle to stick open, posing a risk of serious injury or death to the rider. Units: About 1,700.

title: Stanley Furniture Recalls Cribs Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: The cribs could fail to meet a federal safety standard for crib dimensions. When the mattress support is in the middle setting, the space between the mattress and the crib could be too wide, posing an entrapment hazard to infants. Units: About 1,200.

title: Westminster Inc. Recalls Remote-Controlled Helicopter Toys Due to Risk of Fire
summary: The rechargeable battery inside the helicopter can overheat. This can result in the helicopter's body melting, as well as a risk of fire or burns to consumers. Units: About 102,000.

title: A. O. Smith Recalls Water Pump Motors Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The water pumps with the recalled motors are labeled as containing a one-horsepower motor, but actually contain a 3/4-horsepower motor. Under certain conditions, the smaller motor could overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,750.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Model Year 2008 50cc and 90cc Youth Model ATVs
summary: The speed controller on the recalled ATVs could fail to return to the idle position when the throttle lever is released, or the speed controller could fail to be at idle on start up. title: Dollar Tree Recalls Glue Guns Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled glue guns can short circuit, causing the gun to smoke. This poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 470,000.

title: Jardine Cribs Sold by Babies"R"Us Recalled Due to Entrapment and Strangulation Hazard
summary: The wooden crib slats and spindles can break, creating a gap, which can pose an entrapment and strangulation hazard to infants. Units: About 320,000.

title: Miracle Recreation Recalls Tire Swings Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The hanger clamp on the tire swing can fail, causing the tire swing to detach. This poses a fall hazard to young children and risk of serious injury. Units: About 1,400.

title: Nordstrom Recalls Girls' Sandals Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The flower embellishments on the sandals can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,500.
